description: Controlled vocabulary, business definitions, and ontology for the 9 dental pre-determination decisions defined in decisions.yaml. Every entity below is owned by dental-simulator and READ-ONLY to dental-os.

_verified.method: information_schema.columns + SELECT count(*) per table, with app.tenant_id = 'suwanee_smiles'
_verified.note: Every property name, type and row count in this file was read from the live RDS, not transcribed from a PRD. Where a PRD and this file disagree, this file was checked more recently.

ownership._description: dental-os is the explanation layer. dental-simulator is the system of record. This boundary is enforced, not conventional.
ownership.rationale: dental-simulator assembled pred_states from the payer rules and the ADA criteria. dental-os reads that state and explains it. A write from dental-os into a simulator table would make the decision unreproducible from the simulator alone, which is the one property the whole two-repo split exists to preserve.
ownership.dental_os_own_tables_note: Created by dental-os migrations (migrations/002_dental_os_tables.sql). These are the ONLY tables dental-os writes to. See system_object_types below.

criteria_score.definition: Weighted score (0-1) of how completely the clinical evidence satisfies the ADA criteria checklist for a procedure. 0.85+ sufficient, 0.70-0.84 pend, 0.30-0.69 review, below 0.30 insufficient. Evidence of documentation quality — NOT a diagnosis.

bone_loss_mm.definition: Vertical bone loss in millimetres measured at the site from a periapical radiograph. The ≥3.0mm threshold is what supports D7953 and D6010.

pocket_depth_max.definition: Deepest periodontal probing depth in millimetres from the perio chart. D4260 osseous surgery requires ≥5mm in 6+ sites.

sites_gte_5mm.definition: Count of probing sites measuring 5mm or deeper. Paired with pocket_depth_max to establish periodontal surgical necessity.

cdt_code.definition: ADA Current Dental Terminology procedure code (D-prefixed). The primary key on coverage_rules is payer_id + cdt_code — the same code can carry different rules per payer.

tooth_number.definition: Universal numbering 1-32. NOT FDI and NOT Palmer notation. Tooth #19 is the lower-left first molar and is the reference-scenario site.

tooth_surface.definition: Tooth surface(s) treated, as a combination of M/D/O/B/L/F (e.g. MOD, DO). A billed surface that disagrees with the radiographic finding is a fraud_integrity surface_conflict signal.

annual_max_remaining.definition: Dollars left on the plan's annual maximum for the current benefit year. Note the column is annual_maximum_remaining on eligibility_profiles and annual_max_remaining on pred_states — same concept, two spellings.

waiting_period_met.definition: True when the plan's waiting period for this service category has elapsed since enrollment_start. Major services commonly carry 12 months; implants often longer.

implant_coverage.definition: True when the plan covers implant services at all. When false, every D6-prefixed code is a hard block and the denial is NOT appealable — it is a plan exclusion, not a determination.

missing_tooth_clause.definition: Plan provision excluding replacement of a tooth that was already missing before enrollment. Present on the plan is not the same as confirmed for this tooth — eligibility_profiles carries both missing_tooth_clause and missing_tooth_clause_confirmed.

has_bundling_conflict.definition: True when two billed CDT codes cannot be paid separately on the same date. SOFT (separable with documentation, e.g. D7953 with D6010 under Delta D.7.4) escalates; HARD (e.g. D2950 with a crown under D.4.3) blocks.

downgrade.definition: The code the payer will actually reimburse instead of the one billed (D2740 all-ceramic → D2750 PFM). Not a denial — a lower payment the patient must be told about before treatment.

frequency_limit.definition: How often a code is payable, scoped per_tooth | per_quadrant | per_arch | per_patient (e.g. crown 1 per 5 years per tooth). Detecting gaming against this limit is why fraud_integrity carries a 1825-day context window.

confidence_score.definition: Confidence (0-1) that the fields extracted from a document reflect what the document says. TWO different floors apply to this one value — see confidence_floors below. dental-os gates on 0.70.

extraction_method.definition: How the fields on a piece of evidence were obtained. Enforced by a CHECK constraint. Lets a query distinguish a parsed value from an inferred one from a value we were simply handed.

oig_excluded.definition: True when the provider's NPI appears on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities. Absolute hard stop — no federal healthcare programme may pay this provider (42 CFR 1001.1901(b)).

nppes_verified.definition: True when the NPI was confirmed against the NPPES registry. Dr. Chinta is 1134534266; the earlier 1467573653 is not a registered NPI and must never reappear.

network_status.definition: Whether the provider participates with this payer. Out-of-network escalates (higher cost-sharing, possible gap exception) but never blocks.

coordination_of_benefits.definition: True when the patient carries a second plan. Primary is determined by the birthday rule; the primary EOB must be attached before the secondary claim goes out.

medical_necessity_met.definition: True when the chart establishes that the procedure is clinically necessary. For D7953 specifically this must be established INDEPENDENT of the implant, which is what unbundles it.

open_conditions.definition: Condition codes from conditions_library that are unresolved on this pre-D. Each carries a template, a payer citation, an SLA and an assignee.

decision.definition: The payer's determination on the pre-D. This is the POLICY ENGINE's output, already computed by dental-simulator — dental-os explains it and never recomputes it.

denial_reason_code.definition: X12 standard denial code (96 = not covered, B7 = missing tooth, 97 = bundled). Mapping this to a plain-language explanation plus a policy citation is the whole job of appeal_specialist.

viability_score.definition: Estimated probability (0-1) that an appeal of this denial is overturned. Above 0.40 recommend, 0.20-0.40 escalate. A well-documented D7953 bundling appeal sits near 0.65.

appeal_deadline.definition: Last date an appeal may be filed, typically 60-180 days from denial. Inside 14 days escalates as a deadline warning; past it, blocks.

image_quality.definition: Diagnostic quality of a radiograph. SUBOPTIMAL escalates to a human because a measurement taken off a poor image is not defensible to a payer medical director.

confidence_floors._description: There is no single confidence floor in dental-simulator. There are two, answering different questions. See dental-os docs/PRD.md Known Gap #5.

AI_FALLBACK_FLOOR.question: Is this bad enough that Claude should look at it?

TRUST_FLOOR.question: Is this good enough to base a decision on?

confidence_floors.why: clinical_assembler.py is what gates evidence into pred_states, and pred_states is the only thing documentation_reviewer reads.

eligibility_analyst.purpose: Verify coverage is active on the treatment date and that the plan will pay anything at all for this case.

provider_credentialing.purpose: Validate the treating provider against NPPES, the OIG LEIE, network status and specialty before anything is submitted under their NPI.

fraud_integrity.purpose: Run the integrity detectors across billed lines and supporting evidence — upcoding, phantom procedures, unbundling, frequency gaming, surface conflicts.

coverage_analyst.purpose: Evaluate every billed CDT code against the payer's coverage, bundling, frequency and downgrade rules for this specific plan.

clinical_reviewer.purpose: Score the clinical evidence against the ADA criteria checklist for each billed procedure and surface the measurement against the threshold.

documentation_reviewer.purpose: Answer one question — is the packet complete enough to submit? Presence, currency and extraction confidence for every required document.

pre_d_assessment.purpose: Synthesise all Wave 1-3 outputs into a final submission readiness assessment. The dental equivalent of underwriting_decision.

appeal_specialist.purpose: On a denied or pended payer response, analyse the denial reason, estimate appeal viability, and generate the citation-backed appeal packet.

dso_portfolio_manager.purpose: Cross-location portfolio analytics — denial patterns, revenue at risk, documentation training needs. Advisory only.

ontology.description: Business object model for Accord Dental. The 8 object_types are the system-of-record entities, all owned by dental-simulator and READ-ONLY to dental-os. The catalogue_object_types are reference data loaded by resolvers via rule_loader — no decision reads them directly. The system_object_types are the ONLY tables dental-os writes.

PredRequest.description: The root entity — one dental pre-determination request. Everything else in the model hangs off this. Lifecycle-bound: a resubmission is a NEW PredRequest, never an edit of the prior one. This is the dental equivalent of lending's Application.
PredRequest.id_format: PRED-SIM-DA-{GROUP}{NN} — e.g. PRED-SIM-DA-A01. See CONTEXT.md RULE 14.

links.name: submitted_for
links.semantic_meaning: submitted for patient — one patient carries many pre-D requests over time

links.name: submitted_by
links.semantic_meaning: submitted by provider — joined on provider_npi, the providers table's actual key

links.name: governed_by
links.semantic_meaning: governed by plan — the plan in force determines coverage, waiting periods and the annual maximum

links.name: contains
links.semantic_meaning: contains procedures — one line per CDT code per tooth

links.name: has_coverage_profile
links.semantic_meaning: has coverage profile — assembled from the X12 271 response

links.name: has_computed_state
links.semantic_meaning: has computed state — the assembler output every persona starts from

links.name: supported_by
links.semantic_meaning: supported by evidence — X-rays, perio charts, notes, cards, payer letters

links.name: has_payer_response
links.semantic_meaning: has payer response — the approval, denial or pend that comes back

Patient.description: The WHO. Persists across pre-D requests and across time. Carries the insurance identity — member_id, group_number, payer_id, enrollment_start — which is what the eligibility check and the member-ID mismatch detection both run against.

links.name: has_pred_requests
links.semantic_meaning: has pre-D requests — a patient accumulates them; frequency limits are evaluated across this history

links.name: enrolled_in
links.semantic_meaning: enrolled in plan — enrollment_start is what the missing tooth clause and waiting periods are measured from

Provider.description: The treating dentist. Carries the credentialing posture that gates the whole submission: an OIG exclusion is an absolute hard stop, an unverified NPI or out-of-network status escalates.
Provider.primary_key_note: provider_npi, NOT npi and NOT provider_id — neither column exists. dental-simulator context.md RULE 14.

reference_values.1134534266: Dr. Sridhar Chinta — verified against NPPES
reference_values.1467573653: NOT a registered NPI. Never reintroduce.

links.name: performs_for
links.semantic_meaning: performs procedures for — joined on provider_npi

Plan.description: The benefit structure in force. Everything the eligibility and coverage decisions gate on lives here — annual maximum, deductibles, waiting periods by category, the implant exclusion, the missing tooth clause, and benefit percentages by service class.

links.name: covers
links.semantic_meaning: covers patients

links.name: governs
links.semantic_meaning: governs pre-D requests — the plan is what makes a code covered or excluded

ProcedureLine.description: One billed CDT code on one tooth. The unit that bundling, frequency, downgrade and upcoding checks all operate on. tooth_number is universal numbering 1-32; tooth_surface is what a fraud_integrity surface_conflict compares against the radiograph.
ProcedureLine.primary_key_note: Surrogate bigint. The natural key is (pred_request_id, line_no).

links.name: belongs_to
links.semantic_meaning: belongs to pre-D

links.name: has_cost_breakdown
links.semantic_meaning: has cost breakdown — insurance portion vs patient portion for this line

ClinicalEvidence.description: The document index. One row per piece of supporting evidence, with the fields extracted from it and a confidence in that extraction. 183 rows: 108 with an s3_key (real PDFs) plus 75 structured payloads with no PDF behind them (35 X12_271_RESPONSE, 35 CDT_SUPERBILL, 5 PRED_LETTER_PENDED).
ClinicalEvidence.row_count_note: 183 total, 108 of which have an s3_key. The '108 PDFs' figure quoted elsewhere counts documents, not rows.

extracted_fields_schema._description: extracted_fields is JSONB and its shape depends on document_type. These are the keys the personas read.

ClinicalEvidence.s3_key_note: The S3 prefix uses the BARE scenario id (DA-A01), not the pred_request_id (PRED-SIM-DA-A01). Strip the PRED-SIM- prefix when building a key.

links.name: supports
links.semantic_meaning: supports pre-D

links.name: represented_as
links.semantic_meaning: represented as graph node — typed edges (confirms/corroborates/contradicts) connect nodes and are what fraud_integrity reads

EligibilityProfile.description: Typed columns — not JSONB. Assembled from the X12 271 eligibility response. One row per PredRequest. This is what dental-os eligibility_analyst reads.

naming_traps.annual_maximum_remaining: Spelled in full here. pred_states spells the same concept annual_max_remaining.
naming_traps.implant_coverage: Spelled implant_coverage here. pred_states spells it implant_covered.
naming_traps.missing_tooth_clause: Two columns here — missing_tooth_clause (present on the plan) and missing_tooth_clause_confirmed (confirmed for THIS tooth). pred_states rolls them into missing_tooth_clause_triggered. Do not treat the three as interchangeable.

links.name: describes_coverage_for
links.semantic_meaning: describes coverage for

PredState.description: THE most important entity. Central computed state. dental-simulator assembled this. dental-os reads it. All 9 personas start from PredState. 35 rows: approved=8, denied=7, pended=20.

unwired_columns._description: Present in the schema, not populated. Known Gap #1. Verified against the live RDS 2026-08-05.
unwired_columns.readiness_flags: {} — empty JSONB on all 35 rows, NOT null. A truthiness check passes and an is-null check fails; neither tells you it is unwired. The 14 named checks in dental-simulator PRD §12 are specified but never rolled up.

decision_trace_shape._description: Variable-length JSONB array of assembler findings, NOT one entry per persona. DA-A01 carries 9; other cases carry as few as 4. Do not index into it positionally.

links.name: is_computed_state_for
links.semantic_meaning: is computed state for

catalogue_object_types._description: Reference data. No decisions_that_read_it — resolvers load these via rule_loader and the context enricher attaches the resolved thresholds to the persona bundle. A persona NEVER queries these directly (see CONTEXT.md RULE 4 and RULE 5). Row counts verified against the live RDS 2026-08-05.

CdtCode.description: ADA Current Dental Terminology procedure codes with descriptions and service categories. The vocabulary every procedure line is written in.

AdaGuideline.description: Clinical criteria checklists per procedure with per-criterion weights and thresholds. Layer 1 of the rule hierarchy — the clinical floor that neither payer rules nor the tenant overlay may drop below.

BundlingRule.description: Which CDT codes cannot be billed separately, and whether the bundle is separable with documentation. bundling_separable is the single field that decides whether coverage_analyst escalates or blocks. D7953-with-D6010 is separable; D2950-with-a-crown is not.

FrequencyLimit.description: How often each code is payable, scoped per_tooth | per_quadrant | per_arch | per_patient. The 1-per-5-years-per-tooth limits are why coverage_analyst and fraud_integrity both carry 1825-day context windows.

DowngradeMatrix.description: What the payer will actually reimburse instead of the code billed (D2740 → D2750, D6065 → D2750). Not a denial — a lower payment the patient must be told about before treatment begins.

ConditionsLibrary.description: Global condition-code catalogue. Each entry carries code | category | template_text with ${variable} slots | payer_citation | sla_hours | assignee | recommended_action. This is what turns a signal into a sentence a human can act on.

CoverageRule.description: Per-payer CDT coverage: covered, benefit percentage, pre-D required, tooth eligibility. Primary key is payer_id + cdt_code — the same code carries different rules per payer, which is what DA-C06/C07 exercise. Layer 2 of the rule hierarchy.
CoverageRule.row_count_note: Only 14 rows. Enough to drive the 35 scenarios, NOT enough to run a real practice. Known Gap #4.

system_object_types._description: Runtime artifacts produced by the dental-os decision pipeline. These are the ONLY objects dental-os writes — dental_os_writes: true. They live in dental-os tables created by migrations/002_dental_os_tables.sql, never in dental-simulator tables.

DecisionOutput.description: One row per decision per pre-D per evaluation pass. Append-only and versioned — a re-run adds a row, never mutates one. Carries the human action, so an AI recommendation and the human's disposition of it are both permanently visible.
DecisionOutput.outcome_note: There is no 'allow' outcome. recommend is the ceiling — decisions.yaml has no automate_if clause and no auto_execute mode.

links.name: explains
links.semantic_meaning: explains the computed state — reads it, never writes it

links.name: snapshot_in
links.semantic_meaning: the frozen bundle this decision was computed from

PersonaBundle.description: Frozen snapshot of exactly what a persona saw — entity values, evidence quality, resolved catalogue thresholds, upstream dispositions. Written AFTER decision_outputs commits, in the same transaction. Enables audit, replay and appeal defence. Never read during a live run.

AppealPacket.description: The generated appeal: the payer policy clause applied, the ADA guideline supporting the procedure, the chart documentation meeting criteria, and the measurement that clears the threshold. Produced by appeal_specialist, sent only after a human signs.
AppealPacket.note: dental-simulator has an appeals table with no logic behind it (Known Gap #3). This is the dental-os side that will populate the equivalent.

ProviderFeedback.description: A human override captured as a learning signal for the originating persona. Retained for reflection.retention_days (365) and replayed to the same persona on the next similar case. This is how the system improves without retraining.

execution_order._description: Five waves. Everything inside a wave runs in parallel; a wave starts only when the previous wave has settled. This replaces lending's parallel_independent / sequential_dependent split.

document_types._description: Doc-type → decision permission matrix. The context enricher uses this to filter which document-derived fields appear in each decision's bundle. ObjectType-level permission on ClinicalEvidence is open to the three decisions that read it; the FINE-grained gating lives here. The keys are the actual document_type values present in clinical_evidence on the live RDS.

XRAY_PA.label: Periapical radiograph
XRAY_PA.note: The single most load-bearing document in the product. bone_loss_mm ≥ 3.0 is what unbundles D7953.

CBCT_REPORT.label: 3D cone-beam CT report
CBCT_REPORT.note: Optional for D6010/D7953 criteria but raises the approval rate — a 0.10-0.20 weight in the ADA checklist.

PERIO_CHART.label: Full-mouth periodontal chart
PERIO_CHART.note: Currency window is 6 months, not the 12 that applies to radiographs.

CLINICAL_NOTE.label: SOAP clinical note
CLINICAL_NOTE.note: cdt_codes_noted vs the billed cdt_code is the upcoding detector. A mismatch is far more often a charting slip than fraud.

INSURANCE_CARD.label: Insurance card
INSURANCE_CARD.note: member_id here vs member_id on the X12_271_RESPONSE is the member-ID mismatch check.

X12_271_RESPONSE.label: X12 271 eligibility response
X12_271_RESPONSE.note: 35 rows, one per scenario. No s3_key — structured payload, no PDF.

CDT_SUPERBILL.label: CDT superbill / treatment plan export
CDT_SUPERBILL.note: 35 rows, one per scenario. No s3_key — structured payload from the PMS, no PDF.

PRED_LETTER_PENDED.label: Pre-determination pend letter
PRED_LETTER_PENDED.note: 5 rows. Distinct document_type from PRED_LETTER on the live RDS — do not fold the two together.
